title: Skylight Recalls Power Adapters Sold with Digital Photo Frames Due to Electrical Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The power adapter casing can break when plugged into an electrical outlet, exposing its metal prongs, posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 65,000 (In addition, about 159 were sold in Canada).

title: Skacel Collection Recalls FlipStix Knitting Needles Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The shaft of the knitting needle can split or burst, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 270.

title: RESURRECTIONbeauty Recalls Wintergreen Essential Oil Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The product contains the substance methyl salicylate, which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a poisoning risk if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 270.

title: SCARPA North America Recalls Ski Boots Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The ski boot shell can crack, posing a fall hazard and risk of injury to the consumer. Units: About 4,200 (in addition, 1,200 were sold in Canada).

title: B&B Acquisition Recalls Wintergreen Essential Oils Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The product contains the substance methyl salicylate, which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a poisoning risk if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 62,70

summary: The product contains the hazardous substance oxalic acid. title: Grace Digital Recalls EcoBoulder Speakers That Can Overcharge and Burst; Impact Hazard
summary: The speaker's battery can become overcharged and burst, posing an impact hazard. Units: About 88,000.

title: Flying Tiger Copenhagen Recalls Crocodile Candleholders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The candleholders are flammable and can catch on fire, posing a fire hazard when the candle burns down. Units: About 180.

title: United National Closeout Stores Recalls Isometric Exercise Devices Due to Projectile Hazard; Devices Sold at Burlington Stores After 2014 Recall
summary: The handle grips on each end can break during use and cause parts to be forcefully ejected from the shaft, posing a risk of injury from impact to the user or bystander. Units: About 1,500 (These products were originally recalled in April 2014).

title: Briggs & Stratton Recalls Snapper Rear Engine Riding Mowers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: A faulty blade engagement lever can keep the lawnmower blade engaged after the release of the foot activated disengagement pedal, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 1,160.

title: Kenmore Microwave Ovens Recalled Due to Burn Hazard; Made by Guangdong Galanz; Sold Exclusively at Sears and Sears Hometown and Outlet Stores
summary: Incorrect wiring causes the microwave's exterior to reach temperatures exceeding 183 degrees Fahrenheit, posing a burn hazard to the user. Units: About 700.

title: Quest Products Recalls ALOCANE Emergency Burn Pads Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The pads contain lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children if they were to place the pad in their mouth. Units: About 153,000.

title: Mystery Ranch Recalls Holsters for Semi-Automatic Handguns Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The retention strap can disconnect from the holster and allow the handgun to fall. If this this happens, the gun can unexpectedly discharge, posing a serious injury risk to consumers. Units: About 500.

title: Hooey Recalls Children's Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: A drawstring in the sweatshirt hood poses a strangulation hazard to children. Drawstrings can become entangled or caught on playground slides, hand rails, school bus doors or other moving objects, posing a significant strangulation hazard to children. title: Stanley Black & Decker Recalls Wooden Handle Nailing Hammer Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The molded grip on the hammer can come loose, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 211,000.

title: Mark Feldstein & Associates Recalls Stacked Gourd Jack-O-Lantern Decorations Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The string light wiring inside of the Jack-O-Lanterns can overheat, spark or ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,000.

title: Recalled Products Sold by T.J. Maxx, Marshalls and HomeGoods After Recalls Were Announced
summary: Hazards include infant fatalities, fire, burn, choking, fall, laceration, skin irritation, explosion or other injuries depending on the product. Units: About 1,200.

title: Yamaha Recalls Portable Generators Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The portable generator's fuel tank can leak gasoline, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 10,100.
